title: Evidence-derived graph completeness and honest product verdict v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-420. Product proof can report graph completeness from fixture-shaped or hard-coded canonical relationship completion. Research completeness must instead reflect accepted claims, independent evidence, traceable relationships, and unresolved review risk.
acceptance_criteria: Research graph completeness is computed from accepted claims, valid concept links, evidence-bearing relationships, independent source families, contradiction or qualification coverage, and unresolved needs-review counts.
Hard-coded claim-text fragment to canonical-relationship mapping cannot make a research product proof complete or GO.
Fixture completeness and research completeness are separate named metrics; fixture-mode may remain GO only for engine-contract proof.
A research GO requires zero critical contaminated-source admissions, no unresolved critical review candidates, and minimum independent evidence thresholds defined in the evaluator contract.
Artifacts state mock/live mode, source types, claim-admission policy version, and whether any fixture or canonical completion helper was used.
Existing mock product proof remains useful but is relabeled so it cannot imply arbitrary-source research validity.
On completion, ticket-422 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not delete fixture helpers needed for golden tests.
Do not fabricate independent evidence to satisfy thresholds.
Do not mark a product proof GO solely because graph row counts are nonzero.
Do not add retrieval or answer generation.
rollback_plan: Restore prior product-proof display while retaining the new metrics as diagnostics. Do not restore hard-coded completion as evidence of research validity.
